operations.description: Validate the exact five-element implication envelope and canonical finite bounds.
Enumerate every fixed point of the implication closure operator.
Verify extensivity, monotonicity and idempotence on all subsets.
Verify that the ground set is closed and every pairwise intersection remains closed.
Partition all subsets by equal closure and retain exact class sizes.
Enumerate inclusion-minimal generators for every closed set.
Verify every declared implication against the generated closure operator.
Check reflexive, augmentation and transitive implication consequences by closure.
Verify intersection meets and closure-of-union joins for all closed-set pairs.
Return exact bottom, top and longest strict closed-set chain length.
Count non-bottom closed sets with exactly one lower cover.
Count non-top closed sets with exactly one upper cover.
Detect declarations entailed by the remaining implication set.
Construct the closure-dual interior and verify anti-extensivity, monotonicity and idempotence.
Transport implications through a fixed bijection and compare closure-system invariants.
Restrict closure to four declared labels and reverify its finite laws.
Project subset-equivalence classes ordered by inclusion of their closures.
Represent the finite certificate with explicit definitions and accessibility reservations.
Retain missing observation, affected-party review, consequence and remedy evidence.
Hold real classification, priority or governance actions behind competent authority.
